status: RESEARCH_ONLY / strongest causal contract supportable from valid-vs-invalid BOS material (p1/p4, p4 diagram image-only)
provenance: Farouk Education (2).pdf p1 (priority) + p4 fake-BOS diagram (not transcribed) + MR-016 (BOS candle-close = confidence, not gate) + DR-201 (FVG)

valid_bos_predicate.protected_structural_swing: the swing that PRODUCED the prior opposite extreme (not an internal/irrelevant swing)
valid_bos_predicate.break_beyond_relevant_swing: price trades beyond that protected swing
valid_bos_predicate.completed_close_beyond: a completed candle closes beyond the level WHERE DOCUMENTED (MR-016: close adds confidence; wick-only = weaker)
valid_bos_predicate.displacement_strength: ANNOTATION ONLY — displacement magnitude threshold UNKNOWN (DR-202/MR-012)
valid_bos_predicate.fvg_creation: ANNOTATION — displacement that leaves an FVG marks a stronger break (MR-012 'no-FVG = weak break')
valid_bos_predicate.internal_swing_rejection: internal/irrelevant swings are NOT valid BOS anchors

no_invented_defaults: None of the UNKNOWN fields are given a numeric default and presented as a Farouk rule.
implementation: strategy_router.valid_bos() records: protected-swing candidate, break flag, completed-close-beyond flag, FVG-created flag, displacement=UNKNOWN annotation, internal-swing rejection. Multiple candidates preserved when the protected swing is ambiguous.
note_freeze: router freeze/annotate only; emits NO trade decision
